name: decompose
description: Split a complex business question into smaller sub-questions, dispatch each to a local LLM (e.g. gpt-oss-20b via LM Studio or gemma4 via Ollama), and aggregate the results into a single answer. Returns immediately with an operation ID; the aggregated answer is pushed as a progress notification. Use `await` with the operation ID to retrieve the full result.

custom.usage: Call with a complex question as the input. The tool will decompose it into sub-questions, run each against the local LLM, and return a summarized answer.
custom.local_llm: Requires a local model running via LM Studio (local server on port 1234) or Ollama running on port 11434.
custom.models: Configure the lmstudio settings in ~/.ahma/settings.toml to change your default local LM Studio model, or modify the inlined llm_provider in this file.
custom.privacy: All LLM calls stay on your machine — no data is sent to cloud providers.
